nodes.label: A change enters main by one of three routes, decided by what it carries; one gate enforces the route, and a confirmation in a session is the approval
nodes.summary: A change enters `main` by one of three routes, decided by what the pull request carries and never by a label someone sets: `session` when the one ledger entry it adds carries a confirmation whose fingerprint equals the fact-level diff between the two `graph.json`, `guardrailed` when the ingest runs it carries came from the transcripts folder the project names, and `reviewed` otherwise; one required check, `oto route`, enforces the route's rule, and a route only moves towards `reviewed`.
